property_summary: Once the current owner has transferred ownership to a different address, that former owner loses all control: after a successful transferOwnership(x) by actor, a second transferOwnership(y) by the same actor must revert (or x==actor), a rule C always satisfies since unauthorized calls revert, but M violates because a non-owner can transfer twice in a row.
change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can transfer ownership.
